acceptance.failure: Any unavailable frame, unstable view, failed visual correspondence, response inconsistency or final residual above 3 px stops the controller. The temporary preset is preserved in a private 0600 destination; no preset recall or retry is sent.
acceptance.success: The direct visual return reaches a fresh quiet frame with overlap at least 0.85 and canonical-controller displacement at most 3 px.

hypothesis: For an unmeasured direction, two visually qualified 0.08 s pulses are safer than extrapolating the first response into a 0.15 s correction. The adapter and controller use the same canonical matcher.

recovery.temporary_preset: created before outbound; retained privately unless direct visual return is strict

outcome: SetPreset returned 503 before any outbound movement. A read-only catalog check confirmed that no E7R7 preset was created, so this attempt cannot test the two-observation pulse cap.
